title: Beverly Hills Food Tour with Gourmet Tastings and Drinks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age requirement for alcohol consumption is 18 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You don’t need to be a tourist to enjoy this exclusive glimpse of Beverly Hills. Whether you are from Tokyo, Nashville or even nearby West Hollywood, you’ll savor our highly curated experience through private rooms and secret bars. Over 3.5 hours, 4 generous food tastings, and 2 adult beverages, you’ll walk, wine & dine like the locals in cinematic settings from "Beverly Hills Cop" to "Pretty Woman" and enjoy unique access t9 world famous Rodeo Drive. Come for the food, savor the experience!
